title: An All Rounder
body: I usually don't write reviews from applications but this one is a game changer. I've been look for an app that gives me a weekly overview but then it won't allow me to write my subtasks. TickTick allows me to review my tasks individually when I have cramped several tasks. It has an amazing Pomo which doesn't go on but actually stops once the timer goes off and only starts the rest time until I click 'relax'. You can see all kinds of overview from 'today', three days ahead, weekly and monthly. It has everything wunderlist has but only with much better features. This is the app that is worth purchasing the premium version for. An excellent all rounder app.
